SOL_ID, GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE, CRNCY_CODE

SOL_ID='1144' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='12442' AND CRNCY_CODE='SGD' (WILL BE UPDATED) .
SOL_ID='5009' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='62431' AND CRNCY_CODE='EUR' (WILL BE DELETED) . 
SOL_ID='1232' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='60201' AND CRNCY_CODE='USD' (UNCHANGED) .
SOL_ID=SOL_ID='9999' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='12442' AND CRNCY_CODE='12442'(NEW RECORD) . 

select SOL_ID SOL_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT SOL_ID SOL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE WHERE SOL_ID='1144' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='12442' AND CRNCY_CODE='SGD'
UNION ALL
SELECT SOL_ID SOL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE WHERE SOL_ID='5009' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='62431' AND CRNCY_CODE='EUR'
UNION ALL
SELECT SOL_ID SOL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE WHERE SOL_ID='1232' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='60201' AND CRNCY_CODE='USD'
UNION ALL
SELECT SOL_ID SOL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE WHERE SOL_ID='9999' AND  GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE='12442' AND CRNCY_CODE='SGD' ) temp order by SOL_ID, SCD_START_DATE
